derivation: the first 100 of the parent 200 ids BY SORTED sim_id. Sorted order is chosen deliberately over the parent's stratified proportional_sequential ordering because it is exactly the convention N_test_cosmologies uses (data_selection.py: 'trim the TEST set to the first N cosmologies by sorted sim_id'). That makes this file and N_test_cosmologies=100 select the SAME 100 cosmologies, so an S1/M4b row scored with N_test_cosmologies=100 is directly comparable to a variate row that locks these ids - which is the whole point of the user's 2026-08-25 direction that the 100 test sims be the same and fixed across all variates.
purpose: SHARED, FIXED held-out test set for the Gower variate rows (S2 nla, S3 nla_z, K2 kappa=2). Each of those stores holds exactly the 200 fixed-test cosmologies; locking these 100 into test leaves the other 100 as the finetune/model-selection pool, which the splitter shuffles and cuts by train_frac/val_frac. S1/M4b held out all 200, so these 100 are a SUBSET of what it already excluded: no leakage, and S1 needs no retraining to be scored on them.
